task_description: Implement presigned URL generation for S3 images before sending them to LINE. Use @aws-sdk/s3-request-presigner with getSignedUrl to generate temporary URLs with 6-hour expiry, so that LINE can access private S3 bucket images.

verification.summary: pnpm build, pnpm typecheck, and pnpm test all pass. 6 unit tests across 2 test files: s3.test.ts and handler.test.ts.
